_note: Eight card surfaces. `requires` is what the template cannot be drawn without; `needs` is what it can use. A template that can hold anything makes everything look the same, so each one has a job and an argument about where the eye goes.

templates.name: Day card
templates.best_for: a recurring day: market day, delivery day, bake day
templates.note: the headline sets the offer, the day line carries the when; one accent rule between them.

templates.name: List card
templates.best_for: what is ready this week, up to six lines
templates.note: rows with a hairline between; an optional quantity or price after a vertical bar.

templates.name: Availability portrait
templates.best_for: a longer availability list on a 4:5 post
templates.note: two columns above five items; the list is the composition, not a footnote.

templates.name: Story announcement
templates.best_for: an announcement that has to survive the story chrome
templates.note: safe area reserved top and bottom; nothing important behind the profile row or the reply bar.

templates.name: Market day
templates.best_for: a stall, a venue and a time, stated once
templates.note: the day is the message; the venue and time are the proof; no headline competition.

templates.name: Quote card
templates.best_for: a customer's own words, with their permission
templates.note: the quote is set in the display serif and is allowed five lines; attribution is tracked capitals.

templates.name: Price board
templates.best_for: a retail or market price list, item and price per row
templates.note: rows are 'Item | $0.00'; prices are right-aligned and the rules do the comparing.

templates.name: Carousel cover
templates.best_for: the first slide of a set, where the set needs a title
templates.note: a large numeral sits right; the headline holds the left column.

templates.name: A3 poster
templates.best_for: a gate, window or stall poster, read at 2 m
templates.note: A3 portrait at 300 dpi; the headline is the poster, the day sits in the lower third.

templates.name: A3 sign
templates.best_for: a stall sign read from the footpath at 3 m
templates.note: A3 landscape; the day is the design at roughly 90 mm caps, with venue and time under it.

templates.name: A4 menu
templates.best_for: a counter menu or a market price list, up to ten rows
templates.note: A4 portrait; prices right-aligned to one edge, one hairline under the title and none between dishes.

templates.name: Label proof
templates.best_for: a 100 × 150 mm label front, before the particulars exist
templates.note: A proof only: it reserves the particulars block and reports each missing field as a placeholder. The particulars come from the labelling checklist.
